title: General.
officialText: Heating and air-conditioning systems of the central type shall be provided with approved air filters. Filters shall be installed in the air system, upstream from any heat exchanger or coil, in an approved convenient location. Liquid adhesive coatings used on filters shall have a flash point not lower than 325°F (163°C).
